summary: Babək is a mountain district with a population of 78,400 and an area of 703.9 square kilometres. The neighbourhood has an infrastructure index of 98 and a transport index of 71, though comfort and education indices remain lower at 20 and 18 respectively. There are 3 rail stations and 7 bus stops serving the territory. OSM coverage is low, meaning a portion of objects is not mapped.
